facts.name: Cardinal Flower
facts.notes: Brilliant red spikes in late summer that hummingbirds can't resist. Needs soil that never dries out.

credit.by: Dr. Thomas G. Barnes, USDA-NRCS PLANTS Database

sources.title: Michigan Wildflower Farm: Wetland species list

companions.why: Combines well with great blue lobelia, irises and marsh milkweed; also found with purple coneflower, blazing star and foxglove beardtongue.

sources.title: Wisconsin Horticulture (UW–Madison Extension): Cardinal Flower article
